title: Polynomial threshold function book bound
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the number of Boolean functions on $n$ coordinates that admit a polynomial threshold representation of Fourier degree at most $k$ is at most $2^{n^{k+1}+(2k+1)n^k+1}$.
